properties.author: Scops (Zuordnung laut Dateiseite)

registration.control_method: 4-degree checkerboard coastal blocks held out; Natural Earth 1:110m coast sampled every <=0.2 degree; nearest 1px raster land-boundary contour
registration.notes: single projection plus independent x/y scales and translation; no local warp

projection_candidates_initial.transform_definition: pixel_x=sx*projected_x+tx; pixel_y=sy*projected_y+ty; invert with pyproj inverse after removing scale/translation

properties.adaptation: Current seasonal colors combined after removing thin blue vagrancy-annotation components (max interior radius <=2.2 source px; three substantial winter bands retained); inverse Robinson registration; 3px printed-border closing; 0.45px contour simplification; antimeridian split.
